intro.summary: Inner-city southeast community on the hill beside Inglewood and the Stampede grounds, mostly older single-detached homes with some new infill.
intro.body: Ramsay climbs the hillside between Inglewood and the Elbow River, overlooking the Stampede grounds from Scotsman's Hill. It is one of the city's older neighbourhoods, and most homes are early single-detached houses. Infill is bringing new single-detached and semi-detached homes to its streets.
